skills.skill: I can describe types of data.

items.q: The type of data generated by the survey question ‘How long is your arm length?’ is:
sol: A length can take any value in a range: numerical continuous (E)
items.src: Cambridge Essential Mathematics 9 (3rd Ed), Ch 9 review, multiple-choice Q7 (p. 713)
